Introduction
Mobile phones are an integral part of student life, yet excessive use has been linked to poor sleep quality, which can affect health and academic performance. This study investigates the relationship between daily mobile phone usage and sleep quality among students, aiming to determine whether higher self reported phone use is associated with lower sleep quality scores.
